::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## Workflow boundary

The controller is `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_update_build.do`. It verifies two approved release-stamped CSVs, freezes exact copies with the dated report and instantiates the central Quarto/Observable template. It does not use mutable `*_current.csv` files, approve metrics, apply disclosure control, render Quarto, commit or deploy.

## Inputs

| Input | Authoritative file | Required matching website file |
|---|---|---|
| CVD event release | `$BNR_PUBLIC/metrics/cvd/cvd_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` | `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/datasets/cvd_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` |
| Mortality release | `$BNR_PUBLIC/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` |
| Central template | `$BNR_STATA/reporting/templates/bnr_report_update_template.qmd` | Not applicable |

For each release, the authoritative and website files must have identical size and Stata checksum. A mismatch stops the build and points back to the relevant Step 6.

## Run the builder

Preferred route:

**User > BNR > Rolling three-month CVD update > Build dated online update**

Command-line equivalent:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_update_build.do" ///
    REPORT_YEAR REPORT_MONTH EVENT_YEAR EVENT_MONTH ///
    MORTALITY_YEAR MORTALITY_MONTH REPORT_VERSION [replace]
```

Example:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_update_build.do" 2026 1 2026 1 2026 7 1
```

All periods and the version are whole numbers; years must be 2024 or later, months 1–12 and version at least 1.

## What happens in order

1. Validate arguments and configured roots: `$BNR_REPO`, `$BNR_STATA`, `$BNR_PUBLIC` and `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS`.
2. Require the central template, both authoritative release CSVs and both website mirrors.
3. Compare each mirror with its authoritative source by size and checksum.
4. Check the stable report location. If it already exists, require a strictly higher version and `replace`.
5. Substitute report period, date, ID, version, source IDs and public links into the central template.
6. Stage and verify complete copies of both release CSVs.
7. Write `report.yml`, including source and template fingerprints.
8. Copy the same QMD and frozen CSVs to the authoritative report package and website tree, then verify them.

## Outputs

```text
$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/updates/YYYY-MM/
  index.qmd
  report.yml
  data/
    event_release.csv
    mortality_release.csv

$BNR_REPO/site/surveillance/cvd/reports/updates/YYYY-MM/
  index.qmd
  data/
    event_release.csv
    mortality_release.csv
```

The private log is `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/bnr_report_update_bnr_cvd_update_YYYY_MM_vN.log`.

The authoritative package alone carries `report.yml`; the website instance carries the QMD and its frozen data. The page links to the public release-stamped source downloads.

## Review and publication

Preview the generated page and check the report identity, both release IDs, coverage, cards, charts, source links, protected values and incomplete periods. Then run a complete Quarto render and inspect both report listings.

The generated `index.qmd` is an instance. For a future design change, edit the central template, test it and deliberately rebuild affected instances. Do not turn an earlier dated page into a template.

## Recovery and versioning

Once any output exists for a period, the next build must use a higher version and `replace`. A version is never silently reused or downgraded. If a partial output lacks a consistent authoritative `report.yml`, inspect the package before any recovery; do not overwrite files individually.

Regression coverage is in `scripts/stata/reporting/tests/bnr_report_test_update_lifecycle.do`.
